summary.text: John Lowery is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 47, appointed in October 2025, and is seeking election to the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as Chairman of the Lumbee Tribe of NC.

paragraphs.text: John Lowery was appointed to North Carolina House District 47 on October 7, 2025, by the Robeson County Republican Party Executive Committee to replace Jarrod Lowery (R), and he assumed office on October 13, 2025.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Pembroke among his education.
The General Assembly lists Robeson County for the district and records 0.5 terms of service in the House.
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
